set -eu
Rscript - "/jetstream2/scratch/main/jobs/78560390/inputs/dataset_9097aab6-ef3c-45c2-9e60-6f31073d6cca.dat" << 'REOF'
args <- commandArgs(trailingOnly=TRUE)
data <- read.table(args[1], header=TRUE, sep="	", stringsAsFactors=FALSE)
data <- data[!is.na(data$BMI) & !is.na(data$Efficacy) & data$Efficacy != "", ]
data$PR <- ifelse(data$Efficacy == "PR", 1, 0)
model <- glm(PR ~ BMI, data = data, family = binomial)
aic_val <- AIC(model)
write.table(data.frame(AIC = aic_val), "aic_result.tsv", sep="	", row.names=FALSE, quote=FALSE)
REOF
